title: Cloud test runs keep about 401 GB of build files, free only while the code stays public
what: Every push to any branch saves a full built copy of the admin app plus test pictures, and each app release saves its install files for the default 90 days because no keep time is set. About 4,100 saved files add up to roughly 401 GB today, over 200 GB of it admin app copies. This costs nothing only because the code store is public. If it is ever made private, use is about 800 times the free 500 MB, cloud runs stop or start billing, and nothing warns beforehand.
expected: Save the built admin app only where it is deployed from (the main branch), set a short keep time on every saved file including release builds, and add a size check with a warning well before any limit.
fix_line: Keep the admin app build only from the main branch, give every saved file a short keep time, and warn on total size
